item.title: Nevada man arrested, accused of communicating with Louisiana juvenile
item.description: A man accused of indecent behavior with juveniles was arrested after a Livingston Parish internet crimes investigation.

item.title: 'I am deeply disappointed by the alleged misconduct': CATS CEO responds to vendor fraud indictments
item.description: The CEO of the Capital Area Transit System (CATS) issued a statement expressing disappointment over recent indictments involving vendors contracted to work with the public transportation provider, and committed to implementing safeguards to restore public trust.

item.title: Juvenile arrested after flashing a gun at party in East Feliciana Parish
item.description: The East Feliciana Parish Sheriff's Office arrested a juvenile who was accused of brandishing a gun on Saturday.

item.title: Jury selection begins in trial for Baton Rouge woman charged in child's death
item.description: Jury selection began Monday for the trial of Cardwell, a woman charged in connection with the 2021 death of her 2-year-old daughter, Neveah Allen.

item.title: 127 human trafficking victims in Caddo Parish reported in 2025
item.description: The Louisiana Office of Human Trafficking Prevention reports that in 2025, Caddo Parish had 127 human trafficking victims, East Baton Rouge Parish had 201 victims, and Orleans Parish had 227 victims, with the Caddo Parish Juvenile Court and its STAR Program making strides in supporting juvenile trafficking victims and at-risk youth.

item.title: New state law requires cameras in special education classrooms
item.description: A new state law is bringing expanded monitoring into special education classrooms across Louisiana, requiring continuous audio and video recording in certain instructional settings.

item.title: Louisville rises to 6th in AP women's Top 25, its best ranking in four years, UConn-UCLA 1-2
item.description: Louisville moved up to sixth for its best ranking in four years in The Associated Press women's Top 25 basketball poll released Monday. item.title: Man wanted after being accused of involvement in Clinton parade shooting
item.description: The East Feliciana Parish Sheriff's Office arrested one more person accused of shooting during a Mardi Gras parade on Saturday.

item.title: Louisiana Department of Corrections addresses inmate deaths, drugs at Elayn Hunt Correctional Center
item.description: Louisiana state officials addressed rising concerns at Elayn Hunt Correctional Center following a series of deaths at the facility over the past two years. Data released by the department shows 47 deaths occurred in 2025, with 18 of those classified as unexpected.
